uncited: This family reconstructs continuous volume fields from sparse, irregularly distributed sample points, addressing the limitation of grid-based methods that require structured data.
The family operates on a set of $N$ scattered sample points $\mathbf{x}_i \in \mathbb{R}^3$ with associated scalar values $d_i$.

The core mechanism maps a continuous query point $\mathbf{p}$ to a weighted combination of these samples using a radial basis function $\phi(r)$, where $r$ is the Euclidean distance between $\mathbf{p}$ and $\mathbf{x}_i$.
**Kernel Definition:** A radial kernel $\phi(\|\mathbf{x}_i - \mathbf{p}\|)$ defines the influence of sample $i$ at query point $\mathbf{p}$.
A variant that combines Hardy's multiquadric kernel with local neighbor selection.
